title: UPC Synthesis
description: Multi-source analysis combining evidence across sources (literature review, comparison, memo, answer, evidence matrix). Built from a claim register where each claim cites the evidence and sources that support it. The rendered output MUST cite every id its claims depend on, its bytes are pinned by output.sha256, and every quotation in it is gated by hop C (§04). input_digest lives in provenance only.

question.description: The research question or task this synthesis answers.

path.description: Corpus-relative path to the rendered synthesis (e.g. synthesis.md), generated from claims.

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the output file's bytes; required at L2 for a path output.
